text: The ARUNACHAL PRADESH WATER RESOURCES REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT, 2006 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200615 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 2006-12-15 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The ARUNACHAL PRADESH WATER RESOURCES REGULATORY AUTHORITY ACT, 2006 Long Title: AN ACT to provide for the establishment of the Arunachal Pradesh Water Resources Regulatory Authority to regulate water resources within the state of Arunachal Pradesh, facilitale and ensure judicious, equitable and sustainable management, allocation and utilization of water resources, fix the rates for use of water for agriculture, industrial, drinking and other purposes and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
